intro: Build beyond the hackathon. Explore Penn State's Product Innovation cluster through the ENTI minor, or take the shorter Product Innovation Entrepreneurship certificate. Both paths put making, testing, and launching at the center.
reasons: Open to students from every major.
Choose a full minor or a focused, three-course certificate.
Bring your projects and ideas into the classroom.

tracks.name: Product Innovation cluster
tracks.summary: Explore these core and cluster courses. See the official minor requirements for the complete course plan.

tracks.name: Product Innovation Entrepreneurship
tracks.summary: A suggested three-course path: ENGR 411 plus ENGR 310 and ENGR 407. Other approved options are listed in the certificate requirements.

note: Featured courses are a starting point, not a complete minor checklist. Confirm course availability and your entry-year requirements with an adviser.
